description: SINOE ® - Annuaire 2016 des installations de stockage des déchets non dangereux (ISDND) is published by ADEME. The SINOE directory lists non-hazardous waste storage facilities and their characteristics. Its stated coverage is France; national 2016 facility directory. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. Facility opening dates and historical status do not establish current available capacity. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
